name: Our Mountain
source:
Our Mountain takes place in an isolated region of ancient Japan. One day Kumiko, a woman living alone on the mountaintop, finds two Yokai while collecting herbs. Unable to cross the flooding river due to melting snow and ice, they must stay with her until the river recedes. As they live together their true reason for descending the mountain becomes apparent, thrusting Kumiko into a difficult situation-one that could paint the valley in blood. Will she choose her gut feeling, or will she be swayed by the yokai's words? 

[From [url=https://neeka.itch.io/our-mountain]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们的山发生在古代日本的一个偏僻地区。有一天，独居山顶的女人久美子在采药草时发现了两个妖怪。由于冰雪融化，他们无法渡过洪水泛滥的河流，他们必须和她待在一起，直到河水退去。当她们住在一起时，她们下山的真正原因变得显而易见，久美子陷入了一个可能让山谷沾满鲜血的困境。她会选择自己的直觉，还是会被妖怪的话所左右？

[来自[url=https://neeka.itch.io/our-mountain]Itch.io[/url]]
